title: Dynamic SLO probes with Terraform/SSM for VPC token-saturation and latency detection
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Goal: Implement upgrade-safe, dynamically calibrated SLO probes for private VPC deployments that detect latency regressions, error-rate spikes, GPU/queue saturation, and token throughput degradation. Deliverables: Terraform module to deploy probe configs into AWS SSM for edge-agents to consume; new synthetic token-faucet probe; EWMA smoothing and hold-down windows to avoid false positives during upgrades; integration with rollout controller to automatically pause canaries and optionally route to hosted API when error budgets are exhausted.
comments: 2026-03-01 — Created ticket. Initial proposal based on postmortem for INC-2026-01 (token-throttle during upgrade).

2026-03-03 — Engineering spike: implemented prototype synthetic token-faucet that streams 1–10 concurrent tokenized requests to emulate client workloads. Observed false positives under short transient GC; added EWMA smoothing.
2026-03-05 — Design review (Priya Shah): asked for explicit UX for per-customer SLO overrides and clear 'debug mode' in Console. Added labels for customer-visible toggles.
2026-03-06 — PM feedback (Liam O'Connor): require rollout controller hook to pause canary and send SLA notices when probe crosses severity threshold for >30s.
2026-03-08 — Security review requested; potential sensitive telemetry in SSM parameters. Decided to store only encrypted references and use KMS-backed parameter store. @Security to confirm.
2026-03-10 — Staging run: synthetic probe caused one false alert due to NTP skew between nodes; mitigation: align probe timestamps and add 15s hold-down.
2026-03-11 — Code review PR comments addressed. Diego to validate GPU-util aggregation query accuracy.
2026-03-12 — Ready for canary in staging. Next: create Terraform module release and docs.
tasks: Write terraform module sources/infra/modules/vpc-probes with parameters: probe_type, target_pool, sample_rate, EWMA_alpha, hold_down_secs
Edge-agent: add SSM bootstrap to read probe config and start probe worker
Implement synthetic token-faucet probe with configurable concurrency and model_version tag
Add GPU-util + pending-queue composite probe (weighted metric)
Integrate rollout controller: auto-pause canary and flag fallback_to_hosted when sustained breach
Create Grafana dashboards and alert rules (histograms for p50/p90/p99 and token throughput)
Add e2e tests in staging and run 72-hour soak
Confluence doc + Console UX spec + release notes
notes: Key decisions: 1) Use EWMA smoothing + 15s hold-down to reduce upgrade flapping. 2) Store only encrypted probe references in SSM; probe payload built at agent runtime. 3) Rollout controller will implement tiered severity: alert -> pause canary -> fallback to hosted after configurable duration.
